gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Loud vintage swagger from Woodgod, whose lowercase climbs almost to the capitals. And Noto Sans Gujarati opens its a, e and s into large counters, which is where this pairing is most winning.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Commanding and a bit vintage, Woodgod carries lowercase that nearly meets the capitals. Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with lowercase and open terminals, so extended text moves along without friction.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Commanding vintage punch from Woodgod, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. While Woodgod makes the statement, Noto Sans Kannada is the approachable one, with s curves that open wide at both ends.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Vintage muscle from Woodgod, its lowercase standing almost as tall as the capitals. And Noto Sans Khmer, with openings like chisel notches and proud small letters, makes extended text feel generous and clean.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Woodgod lifts its lowercase nearly to capital height. Noto Sans Khojki meets that with exits wide enough to pass light and a large eye on every e, making the pairing feel commanding yet open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-kr: Vintage and commanding, Woodgod has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. And Noto Sans KR leaves generous gaps in its curves, with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, which is the pairing's best trick.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-lao-loop: Woodgod arrives with a commanding vintage presence, its lowercase climbing so high it nearly matches the capitals. Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks, not skylines.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Woodgod brings vintage command in tall, nearly capital-height lowercase. Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall too, its e given a wide throat like a funnel, which is the thread tying the pair together.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic runs its curvy letters loose and unclamped. Woodgod is the one for big, short bursts of text, where its commanding vintage lowercase can stand near the capitals.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Commanding from the first glance, Woodgod pushes its lowercase high while Noto Sans Medefaidrin lets curves turn without ink pooling. Both fonts lean tall, and that shared height is the link.
